**Mode:** BUILDER (R70 spec item 5 — coev-file lineage chain, [S], first build) + play-tester, vs r70 tip 65707e8 (PR #89 open, Casey-gated; R22-vs-r21 precedent).

## What shipped
- **The lineage chain closes the hop break R70 named**: the coev writer now records `origin: coev.fileName` when the session was loaded from a named file (JSON.stringify drops undefined — a fresh lane's JSON carries **no origin key at all**); the load branch records `fileOrigin` only from a non-empty-string `q.origin` (numeric garbage ignored, never refused); the C1 stats line prints `file "B" (descends from "A")` nested inside the fileName segment (R55 prefix contract byte-intact); `loadCoev` clears `fileOrigin` with `fileName` (artifact boundary extended).
- **6 pins** (`tests/r71-coev-file-lineage-chain-glue.test.js`): WRITE-CHAIN / DISPLAY / CHAIN-OF-CUSTODY / NO-ORIGIN HONESTY / MALFORMED-ORIGIN IMMUNITY / ARTIFACT-BOUNDARY. FAIL-first recorded on the pristine r70 tip: T1/T2/T3 RED in one run. Post-fix 6/6 GREEN; r70 pin re-run 9/9 GREEN.
- **Docs repair**: the R70 PLAYLOG entry shipped below R69 — the R51 newest-first order pin was RED at the shipped tip (measured 297 pass / 1 fail pre-repair, vs R70's claimed 298/0). The R70 block moved above R69 (placement only, text byte-intact). Lesson recorded in the R71 entry: the final suite must run AFTER the PLAYLOG edit.

## Verified numbers (all by running)
- Suite at pristine r70 tip: 306 tests, 297 pass / **1 fail** (order pin) — the wound, measured before repair.
- Post-change: **312 tests, 304 pass / 0 fail / 8 skips**; qa 8/8; README 314→320 (312+8, run-verified).
- prerun @ tip post-change: canonical post-R50 line byte-exact (coev.js 946e639a…, curve f9b20e7d…, L0 bc15d414…, L1 1125d59c…, L2 50137ceb…, stone 3a0a5fb6…; 5 flips / 3 swaps).
- v1 draw #7: 2225 / 738 / **6125 (6000f, 5h, ×3.40)** — L2's shape reproduces R1's published L2 exactly, first tail-match across seven draws.

## Lies measured OPEN (carried to R72 spec)
[M] franken tail (7th carrying, verbatim probe) · [S] lineage-visibility disclosure (6th) · [S] R1 annotation (5th, sharpened by the draw-#7 tail-match) · [S] σ-slider→trail interaction (4th) + 1 NEW: the descent claim should print at LOAD time (found by this round's own play).
